tagline: Instant offline file search — index folders once, then search names and contents as you type, with type filters and sortable results.
description: Find any file the moment you type, like Everything and Spotlight — entirely offline. FindAll 1.1 keeps your indexed folders one click away in a sidebar Sources library (with live file counts), and puts a single search box over everything: results appear as you type, ranked, with size, modified time and a content-match snippet. Narrow by type with one click — Documents, Images, Audio, Video, Other — sort by any column, and open a result (or its folder, or copy its path) straight from the list or the right-click menu. Indexing is a one-time step per folder with a progress bar, optional content indexing and extension filters; re-index any time (F5 re-runs the search). Settings (Ctrl+,) offers the System/Light/Dark theme — the app follows the OS Aura theme live by default. Your files and indexes never leave this device.
